remaining_observations.question: Was optimization still changing near the final epoch?

decision_paths.fitting_separation_bad: Propose one optimization or representation change only after evidence; new fitting requires a new release
decision_paths.fitting_separation_good_held_quality_bad: Investigate transfer/features and family coverage before proposing added independent circuits
decision_paths.evidence_missing: Record missing observations; do not infer convergence, impute metrics, or launch a fifth run

metric_guardrails: Best top-10 regret is not stopped-prefix regret
No seed selection, epsilon relaxation, K increase or outcome-driven exclusions
